teacher.source: frozen normalised BF16 hidden states (32 x [2048,4096]) x pinned BF16 lm_head; BF16 F.linear, FP32 logits, vocab chunks 4096

candidate.scoring_path: served SGLang process, /generate return_logprob (prompt logprobs, logprob_start_len=0, top_logprobs_num=K), input_ids verbatim, no special-token insertion

method.top1_agreement: candidate argmax (server input_top_logprobs[.][0]) == reference teacher_top1, 65,504 positions
method.kl_primary: KL(teacher||candidate) on the coarsened partition {teacher top-K tokens with known candidate logprob} u {rest}: an exact LOWER BOUND of the full-vocabulary KL (data-processing inequality). Labelled kl_lower_bound. NOT the campaign's exact full-vocab KL: the served API returns top-K rows only.
method.kl_secondary: top-K renormalised KL over teacher top-K n known (both renormalised): the common top-K approximation, labelled kl_topk_renorm; not a bound.
method.qfs_row: NOT computed: the QFS protocol inputs/teacher/position count were unavailable in this design (OPEN-QUESTIONS Q8); no QFS-comparable number is claimed.
method.ppl: exp(mean NLL of the true next token) from the same logprobs; teacher PPL recomputed and checked against 3.1995
method.arithmetic_note: candidate logprobs come from the served head path (5-bit EXL3 lm_head, server-side log-softmax), not BF16 head arithmetic; teacher side uses BF16 head arithmetic per the campaign
